message.ascension_foundation.dormant: Your character comes from an add-on that is not installed. It is kept safe and returns when the add-on is installed again.
screen.ascension_foundation.dormant.text: A character is saved for you, but its race, power type or class comes from an add-on that is not installed. Nothing was deleted: install the add-on again to continue with it.
screen.ascension_foundation.no_power: This race has no power type.
screen.ascension_foundation.accept_note: Race, power type and class cannot be changed after Accept.
screen.ascension_foundation.stat_release: Scaled by the power release (shown: now / at 100 %).
screen.ascension_foundation.speed_desc: Running speed while %s is on, at 100 %% release. Grows with %s.
screen.ascension_foundation.life_body: Body is your only life: the hearts are hidden and you fall at 0 Body.

screen.ascension_foundation.level_next: %s more attribute points to the next level
screen.ascension_foundation.tp_desc: Training Points: earned by landing hits in fights, spent on attributes and skills.
screen.ascension_foundation.uc_desc: Upgrade cost of the next %s point(s). Click the multiplier to change it.
screen.ascension_foundation.capacity_des: Learned skills reserve this attribute. Train it to learn more.
screen.ascension_foundation.no_skills: This power type has no skills yet.
screen.ascension_foundation.no_forms: No transformations exist for this power type and race yet.

hair.ascension_foundation.bald_toggle: Switch between bald and a hairstyle

hair.ascension_foundation.transf: Shape change intensity (used by transformations later)

hair.ascension_foundation.reset_group: Reset this group to the preset
hair.ascension_foundation.repeat_desc: The sliders that turn grey copy changes to every group on this page
hair.ascension_foundation.share_desc: Copies your current hairstyle code to the clipboard to share with others
hair.ascension_foundation.paste_desc: Pastes a hairstyle code from the clipboard (Dragonblock C+ / JRMCore codes work too)
hair.ascension_foundation.reset_desc: Resets the current hairstyle to the selected preset
